draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.95, the 152nd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 11th of 19 at DT. He lasted until pick 189, well after his grade rank (152nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Foley Fatukasi. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2 sacks in 2020, 10th of 19 DTs in his class with stats.
